title: The closing window: consolidation and the time left for counter-infrastructure
description: These forecasts hold that the window for building open, provenance-preserving infrastructure is closing: regulatory capture, corporate consolidation, training cycles that narrow capacity, and professional standards that ossify around early definitional acts, which Meaning Feudalism (#791) applies to Google's June 2026 guidance. They run from The Third Space (#300) and The Stakes (#476) through the Distributed Journal call for papers (#57), ChatGPT Psychosis (#124), Retrievability as the Medium of Existence (#753), Meaning Feudalism and The Gray Hypothesis (#1063). Several (#124, #754) add that the counter-design will not come from inside the labs. The page also holds fourteen unrelated claims, from the Maduro case and Effective Altruism to mycelial packaging and Pound's Cantos.
